question.text: Which of the following compounds is not expected to show Lassaignes' test for nitrogen ?

solution.text:
Lassaigne's test is used for the detection of nitrogen and given by all nitrogenous compound except diazo
compounds. This test is shown only by the compounds containing $\mathrm{C}$ and $\mathrm{N}$ both hence hydroxyl amine hydrochloride $\left(\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{NOH} . \mathrm{HCl}\right)$ will not perform this test.
